answer: Presence is the scarce resource: at unpredictable moments each epoch, a random sample of agents must finish a short interactive task inside a narrow window. One honest agent answers in seconds, tracing a single route on an atlas. A farmer’s attention drains like water into karst — one operator cannot be in a thousand places at once, and hiring a thousand stand-ins costs more than the clones earn. Miss the window and the identity sleeps until the next round, while violet flags mark repeat misses for review. Limit: it punishes agents legitimately offline, so one miss must be forgiven.
